name: Darkcloud Pinnacle
summary: Grimtotem tauren hold Darkcloud Pinnacle above the canyon east of the Great Lift. From their linked mesas, they disrupt the region and pursue secret dealings.

sections.title: A Clifftop Stronghold
sections.body: Darkcloud Pinnacle rises above the canyon basin across three main mesas, joined by rope bridges. You can climb a steep natural slope from the canyon floor, then cross wooden bridges. A high crossing near Razorfen Downs offers another way up. From these windswept rocks, Grimtotem watchers survey the valley. The heights guard them from easy attack and leave them apart from the wider tauren tribes.

sections.title: Schemes on the Mesas
sections.body: Arnak Grimtotem and Harb Foulmountain are among the leaders directing Darkcloud Pinnacle. Correspondence found on the mesa points to Grimtotem dealings with dark, unknown powers. Their ambitions reach beyond the peace Cairne Bloodhoof forged in Thunder Bluff.

faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan holds Darkcloud Pinnacle. These aggressive, reclusive tauren are hostile to most outsiders and deeply distrustful of the Horde.

faq.q: How do you reach Darkcloud Pinnacle?
aliases: how to get up darkcloud pinnacle
faq.answer: You can climb a natural ramp from the canyon floor to an adjacent mesa, then cross wooden rope bridges. Another route crosses a bridge near Razorfen Downs.
Arnak Grimtotem and Harb Foulmountain are among the prominent Grimtotem figures overseeing the settlement.

faq.q: What are the Grimtotem plotting here?
aliases: what is happening at darkcloud pinnacle
faq.answer: The Grimtotem at Darkcloud Pinnacle keep secret communications with an unknown dark influence. Their shadowy goals threaten stability in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the Grimtotem's treachery on these mesas set against the unity and peace Cairne Bloodhoof seeks among the tribes.
As a member of the Horde, you find the Grimtotem hostile here. They menace travelers passing from the Great Lift into Thousand Needles.
